title: Run check_migration with PyPI mlflow pre-migration and the locked env post-migration
answers: how do I run the database migration check locally
check_migration pre-migration uses latest mlflow from PyPI
how to regenerate tests/db schema after the uv.lock change
body:
Pre-migration uses the latest PyPI mlflow with the locked drivers: export the lock with `uv export --locked --no-default-groups --extra db --group db-test --no-emit-workspace --no-hashes --output-file "$locked"`, then run `uv run --isolated --no-project --with mlflow --with-requirements "$locked" python check_migration.py pre-migration`.
Post-migration uses the repository's mlflow in the synced project env: `uv run --no-sync mlflow db upgrade $MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI`, then `uv run --no-sync python check_migration.py post-migration`.
Flags: `--isolated` keeps the PyPI run out of the project env, `--no-project` stops uv from reading pyproject.toml, `--no-emit-workspace` keeps the repo itself out of the exported requirements.
Schema regeneration: tests/db/update_schemas.sh now runs `compose.sh build` with no build arguments.
applies: Running tests/db/check_migration.sh or update_schemas.sh locally or in CI; assumes uv is installed.

Post-migration runs mlflow db upgrade $MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI followed by check_migration.py post-migration, while tests/db/update_schemas.sh regenerates schemas via compose.sh build without arguments.
